market_reference: CrowdStrike, an investor in Abnormal through its Falcon Fund and a seller to the same security leaders, has been a Mercedes partner since 2019 and is now a Principal Partner. Its Falcon platform protects the team at the factory and at races, and it hosts its top customers at Driving Ambition, a track event with hot laps alongside Toto Wolff.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team knows what normal looks like for every system on the car and acts the moment something changes. Abnormal learns how each person and supplier normally behaves and stops emails and logins that break the pattern.

priority.reason: Well funded leader in email security with a new CMO hired this month to build a global brand and several customers already on the grid, but security seats are taken at most teams and its last raise was in 2024.
